scope: Descriptive sidecar for the existing public as-built dataset; not an inventory or topology replacement.

source_policy.earth_export_status: Predates approved final corrections; fresh export pending.
source_policy.power_policy: Recorded equipment power-source facts are included; unknown installed feeds remain unknown. Device capability is not wiring evidence.
source_policy.location_policy: Map groups are organizational only; they do not prove co-location, service coverage or network connectivity.
source_policy.coordinate_policy: No coordinates are supplied or changed here. Preserve the base dataset: 049-USW-Flex altitude null and approximate placement; KML elevations unvalidated, not mounting heights; Site 96 placements unresolved; no snapping or stored display offsets.
source_policy.path_policy: Paths run from device back to the main router, not to internet/WAN. Each hop uses the existing public link, traversed child-to-parent. Station LAN links are wired, not wireless. Wired cable subtype is unknown unless explicitly recorded; SFP+ is an interface, not evidence of fiber or DAC.
source_policy.private_network_policy: Private family network (not part of guest service). Existing WAN aliases stay unchanged; no household details or private alias mapping are included.
